journal_lines: Sword made of something old. Didn't let it land.
Deep place for a thing like this.
Coal-colored bone and a coal-cold blade. Nothing here was warm.
Stood in a doorway that no longer had a door. Did the doorway's job.
Took a swing that grazed the fur. The fur turned grey for an hour after.
Old armor, older bones, oldest grudge.
Smelled like a forge that had gone cold a long time ago.
It did not speak. It did not have to.
Coal-fragments where it fell. Carried what was useful. Left the rest.
Underworld thing in a place that almost was not underworld. Almost.
